title: Neon Pulse — Episode 7: The Offshore Coordinates
description: Kael tracks decrypted coordinates to an offshore research platform, only to discover automated defenses and a chilling countdown.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves

scenes.narration: The coordinates led me past the jagged coastline into the freezing open sea, where a massive industrial platform loomed through the fog.
scenes.visual: A massive steel industrial research platform rising from dark, choppy ocean waters under a thick, overcast night sky, wide cinematic angle, dramatic lighting.

scenes.narration: I scaled the rusted maintenance ladder in the biting wind, my jacket glowing faintly against the pitch-black metal hull.
scenes.visual: Close-up shot of hands gripping a rusted metal ladder against a dark ocean backdrop, sea spray catching the dim ambient light.

scenes.narration: Stepping onto the service deck, I forced open a heavy security hatch, sliding into the dark facility below.
scenes.visual: A heavy metal hatch pried open, revealing a dark, cavernous industrial corridor illuminated only by emergency red floor lights.

scenes.narration: The data drive in my hand vibrated, reacting to the complex network humming through the walls of this secret installation.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a hand holding a glowing data chip that pulses with bright energy inside a shadowed control room.

scenes.narration: Suddenly, automated turret systems pivoted from the ceiling, locking their targeting lasers directly onto my position.
scenes.visual: Multiple red laser targeting beams crisscrossing across a narrow industrial corridor, casting sharp shadows on metallic walls.

scenes.narration: I channeled the amber energy through my arms, unleashing a massive kinetic blast that shattered the security drones into scrap metal.
scenes.visual: A powerful shockwave of bright amber light exploding down a metal corridor, sending metallic debris flying in all directions.

scenes.narration: An alarm wailed overhead as a central holographic monitor activated, displaying a countdown and a message from the shadowy architects.
scenes.visual: Glowing digital numbers counting down on a large circular control console in a high-tech laboratory, casting an eerie blue light.

scenes.narration: The facility was set to self-destruct, and the true mastermind was watching every move I made from the shadows.
scenes.visual: A pair of cold eyes watching from the darkened glass window of a high surveillance control booth overlooking the lower decks.

scenes.narration: Follow along for more chapters in the journey to uncover the truth.
scenes.visual: A dramatic low-angle shot looking up as a figure turns away from a glowing control panel, stepping resolutely into a dark hallway.
